charts.title: Free-diffusion limit — DiffusionForce vs RandomMotionForce
charts.caption: Mean squared displacement of 144 non-interacting walkers under mainline DiffusionForce (coral, ±SEM) against the analytic 4·D·t line the paper's RandomMotionForce also follows (D = xi = 0.1).
charts.interpretation: Measured MSD 0.383 vs theory 0.400 (z = −0.56) — a match. The calibration scaling = xi·radius makes DiffusionForce a sound substitute in the free limit (OS, VM).

charts.title: DiffusionForce substitution — viability by model
charts.caption: Which models can use mainline DiffusionForce for the paper's random motion: sound for OS and VM, mechanically blocked for VT.
charts.interpretation: OS/VM keep node radii so DiffusionForce runs and matches the free limit; VT's per-step remesh discards radii, so VT remains deterministic — a refutation carried from cbc-02.
